description: Karnataka Budget 2026: Karnataka's Budget 2026-27 introduces the innovative Kaveri 3.0 registration system, integrating AI and GIS technology to streamline property registration and enhance land management transparency. Discover the impactful housing initiatives and infrastructure developments announced in the budget.
body_lead: Karnataka to roll out AI-based Kaveri 3.0 registration system, GIS land stack under Budget 2026 Karnataka's Chief Minister has unveiled a budget focused on modernising land records and property registration. New systems will streamline processes and enhance transparency. Bengaluru will see significant infrastructure upgrades, including road development and stormwater drain improvements. The state also plans to build more houses, increasing subsidies for beneficiaries.
